description: Fetch the lead summary of any English Wikipedia article — the fast, grounded way to facts about companies, people, places and concepts. Fuzzy titles resolve via Wikipedia search, and the response includes the canonical page URL, short description and thumbnail. Use this when an agent needs to grounded facts for any notable entity. x402 price $0.003/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: live_wikipedia_summary
title: Wikipedia Summary
